inline_text:
Could Hive be considered for the Orchestration & Multi-Agent category, or should we wait until it reaches the landscape's general 1,000-star threshold? Hive currently has 63 stars; this request is for eligibility guidance, not a claim of AAIF membership or endorsement.

Hive is an Apache-2.0 orchestration layer that dispatches to Goose at fleet scale, alongside other coding-agent backends. It provides operator-controlled scheduling, policy gates, and contributor-compute relays. Goose's canonical upstream is now aaif-goose/goose.

Project and review material:
- Repository: https://github.com/hivecommons/hive
- OpenSSF Best Practices badge: https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/14261
- License: https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/blob/v5/LICENSE
- Security self-assessment: https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/blob/v5/src/docs/security-self-assessment.md
- CNCF reference architecture: https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/blob/v5/src/docs/cncf-reference-architecture.md
- Tracking issue: https://github.com/hivecommons/hive/issues/10627

Your README specifies a landscape.yml PR with an SVG logo for new entries. Before proposing that change, we'd appreciate confirmation that a smaller open-source downstream Goose orchestrator is eligible and which existing category best fits it.
